verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents a full REST API with a toggle-feature endpoint for switching flags per environment (docs-12, docs-58). It also ships an official MCP server that calls the REST API with Agent Skills guardrails (docs-13, docs-21, probe-3). On governance, it documents draft revisions with required approval before publishing (docs-5, docs-16), and its API docs say "Require confirmation" holds risky changes until a person confirms them (docs-72). Approval workflows are gated to the top pricing tier (docs-16). Missing for 10: explicit documentation that approval rules are enforced on API/MCP-originated writes (only implied by docs-72), an explicitly cited flag-creation endpoint, any CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent changes being gated.
